title: objectql: the engine's function holder set follows ruling A's served-holders default
body:
domain:server#4 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgWRcTEB3toGxnWvuvX

Hardening follow-up of #32534 (routed by the epic seat's red-line read of PR #32877). Pre-existing on `main`.

Filing gate: ② an epic-seat routing. class: b · type: Hardening · Suggested-grade: p2 · lane: `domain:server`.

## Rule to align with

Ruling A 6824698376 and #32497: a by-name read counts served holders by default, and only every-holder reads (install door, item seam, seal) pass `includeDisabledPackages`. The engine's function holder set should follow the same default as the registry's holder reads, so a function read by bare name, or by package with no caller package, answers from served holders only, while the every-holder judgements keep counting a disabled package as a holder.

## Do

- Align the engine's function holder bookkeeping with the registry's package enable/disable state under that default.
- Pin both sides: served-only for the bare and caller-less reads; every-holder for the doors that count a disabled holder.
- Declare any moved answer with its `Clause-②` arm (AGENTS.md step 3).

Reader who acts: `packages/objectql/src/engine-hooks-and-functions.ts`, `packages/objectql/src/registry.ts` and their tests.
